# Fixture provenance

`sherlock-live.csv` and `maigret-live.csv` are actual CSV outputs from the audited upstream commits installed on Linux and queried for the public test username `octocat` on 2026-10-17 WIB. They are not proof of identity. They deliberately preserve disagreements and unavailable source states. Maigret's GitHub selection includes GitHubGist in the pinned database.

Other fixtures in unit tests are explicitly synthetic contract/error inputs. The demo command always labels its case OFFLINE FIXTURE. No personal target supplied by a user was investigated.
